decision: filed the settings-build drift as an inbox capture and restored the file

evidence: .audit/clean-assets/A2_cmake_source_lists.txt; per-component runs on ores.iam.api and ores.refdata.api also stale

decision: registered assets as a composite component: catalogue row, component model with component_kind and parts, regenerated root CMakeLists

decision: proved the scaffold changes exactly one generated file before committing it
why: a draft model in a modeling directory materialises output nobody authorised, and the in-place drift mode clobbered hand-written files on 2026-09-19
evidence: check_component_drift.py --component assets-cpp --dry-run: 1 file would change, 0 would be created
result: only projects/ores.assets/CMakeLists.txt changes, and its add_subdirectory lines are byte-identical

decision: re-ran every read-only gate after the scaffold
why: a catalogue row widens what other gates iterate, so the change had to be measured against its own baseline
